arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (fiscal years)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize with first observation
years = sorted(data.keys())
smoothed = {}

# First smoothed value = first observation
smoothed[years[0]] = data[years[0]]

print(f"Year {years[0]}: X = {data[years[0]]}, S = {smoothed[years[0]]}")

# Calculate smoothed values for each subsequent year
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    year = years[i]
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    smoothed[year] = alpha * data[year] + (1 - alpha) * smoothed[prev_year]
    print(f"Year {year}: X = {data[year]}, S = {smoothed[year]}")

# The forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value for 1967 (one-step-ahead forecast)
forecast_1968 = smoothed[1967]
print(f"\nForecast for fiscal year 1968: {forecast_1968}")
EOF
